info.name: ConnectJob — Integration Feature
info.description:
Full collection for the ConnectJob ↔ WingDigital ERP integration feature.

**Setup:**
1. Set `base_url` to your server (e.g. `http://localhost:8000`)
2. Login and paste the JWT into `jwt_token`
3. Paste Key_Beta (outbound key) into `connector_key` for ERP-side calls

**Folders:**
- Auth — get a token
- Integration Lifecycle — handshake, exchange, disconnect, category/user lookups
- Data Mapping — field + value mapping CRUD (19 field defaults + 9 category value defaults auto-seeded on connect)
- Inbound Job Posting — ERP posts a job vacancy (payload auto-transformed via mappings)
- Recruiter Integration Tab — company integration settings
- Operator — Link User to WingDigital — link an ERP user to a ConnectJob UserCompanyProfile (one user, many companies)
- Operator (Admin) Company — admin company management with integration tab

**Category mapping defaults (seeded automatically on connect):**
Job Category field: default_value = 'Other' (unknown ERP categories fall back to Other)
9 pre-seeded value mappings: Business & Management, IT, Engineering & Technical, Education & Training, Sales & Marketing, Customer Service & Support, Finance & Accounting, Legal & Compliance, Healthcare & Medical

variable.description: Key_Beta — ERP outbound key for inbound ERP calls
ERP's own user ID, picked from 'Lookup ERP Users' response — becomes IntegrationUserMapping.partner_user_id
Email for the ConnectJob User created/linked to the ERP user
Set from response — UserCompanyProfile.id created by 'Link ERP User to Recruiter'
Set from response — User.id created by 'Create Admin User (with WingDigital Link)'

item.name: Auth
item.description: Obtain a JWT token. Paste the access token into the `jwt_token` collection variable.

item.name: Integration Lifecycle
item.description: PKCE handshake flow to establish the connection between ConnectJob and WingDigital ERP.

request.description:
Called by the ConnectJob frontend (JWT required).
Returns: authorize_url (redirect browser here), code_verifier, state, temporary_code.
Store code_verifier and state in sessionStorage — needed for step 3.

Called by ConnectJob frontend after browser returns from WingDigital.
Requires JWT + X-Code-Verifier header (from sessionStorage).
On success, creates IntegrationPartner + seeds 19 default field mappings.
Returns: { status: 'success', message: 'Integration connected successfully.' }

Called server-to-server by WingDigital ERP when user clicks 'Disconnect'.
Auth: X-CONNECTOR-KEY header with Key_Beta value.
Sets IntegrationPartner.status = 'disconnected' (soft delete).
Returns: { status: 'success', message: 'ConnectJob integration disconnected.' }
Proxy call — ConnectJob frontend triggers this; ConnectJob calls WingDigital server-to-server using Key_Alpha. Returns the list of ERP users for the connected company.

query.description: Returns ConnectJob's own JobCategoryModel list — used to populate the Source Value dropdown in Data Mapping UI
Proxies to ERP's /api/connector-integration/categories using Key_Alpha — used to populate the Target Value dropdown

request.description:
Proxies to WingDigital ERP using Key_Alpha (X-CONNECTOR-KEY) to fetch the ERP's own category list.
Used by the Data Mapping UI to populate the **Target Value** dropdown for the 'category' field.
Returns 404 if no active integration exists for the company.

item.name: Data Mapping
item.description:
Configure field-level and value-level mappings between WingDigital fields and ConnectJob fields.
All endpoints require JWT (recruiter of the connected company).

**Auto-seeded on connect:**
- 19 field mappings (title←position, category←job_category with default='Other', salary_min←min_salary, etc.)
- 9 job category value mappings under 'category' field (Business & Management, IT, Engineering & Technical, etc.)

**Category lookup endpoints** (for populating dropdowns in the UI):
- GET /look_up/categories → ConnectJob categories (Source Value dropdown)
- GET /look_up/categories?side=erp → ERP categories via proxy (Target Value dropdown)

request.description:
Returns all active field mappings for the company's integration, ordered by source_field.
Each row includes nested value_mappings array.

source_field: ConnectJob field name (must match InboundJobPostSerializer field)
target_field: WingDigital ERP field name
mapping_type: 'free' (direct copy) or 'mapped' (has value-level mappings)
default_value: used when ERP omits this field

item.name: Value Mappings
item.description:
Manage value-level mappings within a field (for enum/choice fields).
Many ERP values can map to one ConnectJob value (many-to-one).
Constraint: each ERP value (target_value) must be unique per field.

request.description:
source_value: ConnectJob category/value
target_value: ERP category/value
Auto-promotes field mapping_type to 'mapped'.
Deleting the last value mapping auto-demotes the field back to mapping_type='free'.

item.name: Inbound Job Posting (ERP → ConnectJob)
item.description:
WingDigital ERP posts job vacancies to ConnectJob.
Auth: X-CONNECTOR-KEY header with Key_Beta (ERP outbound key).
Payload uses ERP field names — the system auto-transforms them using configured field mappings.

body.raw:
{
  "position": "Senior Software Engineer",
  "job_code": "JD-2026-001",
  "description": "We are looking for a senior engineer...",
  "requirements": "5+ years experience in Python and Django.",
  "responsibilities": "Build and maintain backend services.",
  "benefits": "Health insurance, remote work options.",
  "job_category": "IT",
  "job_level": "Senior",
  "job_type": "Full Time",
  "employment_type": "Permanent",
  "remote_type": "Hybrid",
  "department_code": "Phnom Penh",
  "min_salary": 1500,
  "max_salary": 3000,
  "salary_type": "RANGE",
  "currency": "USD",
  "no_of_positions": 2,
  "expire_date": "2026-12-31",
  "experience_years": "3-5 years"
}

request.description:
ERP field names are transformed via the configured data mappings:
  position → title
  job_category → category (with value mapping: IT → IT)
  min_salary + max_salary → salary_range (NumericRange)
  currency → salary_currency
  department_code → location
  job_type → time_type
  employment_type → contract_type
  no_of_positions → hire_no
  experience_years → year_of_experience

Returns: { status: 'success', job_post_id: '<uuid>' }

item.name: Recruiter Integration Tab
item.description:
Recruiter manages their company's integration settings.
All endpoints require JWT. Company is resolved from the JWT's company_id claim.

request.description:
Returns:
  integrate_domain: the configured ERP domain
  is_integrate: whether company was imported from ERP
  integration: null (no domain) | { is_connected, partner_tenant_id, status, connected_at }

Saves the integrate_domain on the company. Call this before /initialize.
is_integrate is read-only and cannot be set here.

Recruiter disconnects from WingDigital.
Best-effort notifies ERP, then marks IntegrationPartner.status = 'disconnected'.

item.name: Operator — Link User to WingDigital (UserCompanyProfile)
item.description:
Links a WingDigital ERP user to a ConnectJob UserCompanyProfile (one company membership for one user). Since a ConnectJob user can belong to multiple companies (UserCompanyProfile per company), the ERP identity is pinned to the specific UserCompanyProfile via IntegrationUserMapping.user_company_profile — not to the raw user/profile — so it never collides across companies.

Flow:
1. Connect the company to WingDigital (creates the IntegrationPartner) — skip if already connected.
2. Lookup ERP users for the company and pick one (erp_user_id).
3. Link that ERP user to a new/updated ConnectJob recruiter — creates User + Profile + UserCompanyProfile and writes IntegrationUserMapping with partner_user_id pre-populated.

request.description:
Requires JWT + operator_manage_company permission.
Generates Key_Beta, calls WingDigital's /api/connector-integration/operator-connect, then creates the IntegrationPartner row for company_id and seeds default field mappings.

Skip this request if the company already has an active integration (check via 'Lookup Company by Domain' in the Integration Lifecycle folder).

Requires JWT only (operator's own company_id claim is used to resolve the IntegrationPartner). ConnectJob calls WingDigital server-to-server with Key_Alpha and proxies back the ERP's user list. Copy the id of the user you want to link into the `erp_user_id` collection variable.

item.name: 3. Link ERP User to Recruiter (creates UserCompanyProfile)

request.description:
Requires JWT + operator_manage_user permission. company_id must have an ACTIVE IntegrationPartner (see request 1).

role_type: 'admin_recruiter' or 'recruiter'.

Behaviour:
1. Resolves an existing active User by email, or creates one.
2. Resolves or creates that User's Profile.
3. Rejects with 400 if a UserCompanyProfile already exists for this user + company (one ERP user maps to exactly one UserCompanyProfile per company).
4. Creates the UserCompanyProfile (this is the specific 'this user, at this company' membership record).
5. Writes IntegrationUserMapping(connection=partner, user_company_profile=<new ucp>, partner_user_id=erp_user_id) immediately — no need to wait on the async recruiter-sync task since the ERP id is already known here.

Returns user_id, profile_id and ucp_id — save ucp_id into `recruiter_ucp_id` for use in Job Management requests (e.g. filtering 'my job posts' by create_ucp_id).

item.name: 4. Create Admin User via OperatorUserView (multi-company, WingDigital link)

request.description:
Generic operator user management (ModelViewSet), as an alternative to request 3 above. Requires JWT + operator_manage_user permission.

`companies` accepts multiple entries in one call — one User can get a UserCompanyProfile in several companies at once. `erp_user_id` is optional per entry: set it only for companies that have an active WingDigital integration; validate_companies() rejects the request up front (400) if erp_user_id is given for a company with no active IntegrationPartner.

`roles` was omitted here — CompanyInputSerializer auto-fills the default admin-recruiter role when not provided.

`password` must be encrypted client-side with the same scheme as Login (see EncryptionMixin) before sending — left blank here since Postman can't replicate that encryption; a blank password leaves the account requiring the invite/reset-password flow (OperatorSendInviteView) before first login.

On success, writes IntegrationUserMapping the same way request 3 does, via the new _link_erp_user() helper in AdminUserSerializer.

item.name: 5. Update Admin User — Add/Change WingDigital Link

request.description: Re-runs the same company-assignment loop as create, so it can also be used to attach or repoint a WingDigital erp_user_id on an existing admin user — e.g. when they're added to a second, newly-integrated company. update_or_create() on IntegrationUserMapping means calling this again with a different erp_user_id re-points the mapping instead of duplicating it.

item.name: Operator (Admin) — Company Management
item.description:
Admin operator manages companies. Integration tab fields are included automatically.
All endpoints require JWT + operator_manage_company permission.

request.description: Includes integrate_domain and is_integrate in each row.

Returns full company detail including:
  integrate_domain, is_integrate
  integration: null | { is_connected, partner_tenant_id, status, connected_at }
  employees: [...]

integration is null when no integrate_domain is set.

request.description:
Called by ERP to register its company profile into ConnectJob.
Idempotent on integrate_domain — re-submitting syncs the existing record.
Sets is_integrate=True, access_type=EXTERNAL, entry_type=INTEGRATION.
Returns the ConnectJob company record for a given ERP domain.
